releases.notes:
> [!WARNING]
> **Public Beta Test Build**
> This is a **beta test release** of **HBM-Modernized (`0.3.0-beta.2`)** and the **Space-Modernized (`0.1.0-beta.2`)** addon.
> **Back up your worlds before installing or updating — do NOT use this build in important worlds without backups!**
> Bugs, crashes, visual glitches, and balance/API changes are expected during beta testing.

## Highlights

- **WIAJ (World-in-a-Jar) Demo Scenes:** Added 15 scripted interactive guide scenes for Conveyors, Particle Accelerator / Synchrotron, and RBMK (Intro, Basics, Starter, Advanced).
- **Satellites & Soyuz Launch Pipeline:** Completed the Soyuz launchpad sequence, satellite dock & miner-launch logic, satellite frequency/tooltip fixes, and `SatelliteMapper` updates.
- **RBMK & Machine Rendering:** Migrated RBMK columns and controls to Nucleus MDI dynamic parts with whole-column selection outlines and DODD diagnostic dumps; restored in-hand/non-GUI 3D column rendering, 1.7.10 pipe nozzles, ReaSim bottom/fuel variant textures, and `level`/`targetLevel` lines in control rod DODD; fixed conveyor press belt animation/stamp validation/energy sync and added 3-segment (`bottom`/`middle`/`top`) conveyor lift variants.
- **Airstrikes, Planes & Audio:** Aligned `AirstrikeItem` designators with 1.7.10 `EntityBomber` (500-block range, sky/miss targeting), restored `BomberRenderer` Dornier (`5x`) & B-29 (`30/3.1x`) scale and orientation, and fixed bomber loop sound attenuation to 250 blocks.
- **Space-Modernized Sky & Shader Fixes:** Routed additive sky quads through `PackAdditiveQueue` with shader bind resync, fixed sunset blending, Dyson swarm depth-write guards, and `ThatmoSkyRenderer` depth state.
- **Worldgen, Structures & Bug Fixes:** Fixed issues `#191`, `#211`, `#212`–`#218`, `#220`–`#225`, and `#227` (multiblock light cache invalidation, fusion beam & immediate vertex rendering, wood burner hitbox alignment, crate & anvil persistence on 1.21.1, strawberry bush placement, structure fence connections & door normalization, airstrike chunk tickets & salvo centering, and vine placement softlock); removed duplicate oil feature generation.
- **No extra dependencies required:** Architectury API is embedded (Jar-in-Jar) directly inside the mod.

## Included Downloads

| Mod | Version | 1.20.1 (Forge) | 1.21.1 (NeoForge) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **HBM-Modernized** (`hbm_m`) | `0.3.0-beta.2` | `hbm_m-0.3.0-beta.2+1.20.1-forge.jar` | `hbm_m-0.3.0-beta.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar` |
| **Space-Modernized** (`space_m`) | `0.1.0-beta.2` | `space_m-0.1.0-beta.2+1.20.1-forge.jar` | `space_m-0.1.0-beta.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar` |

**Notes:**
- **Architectury API** is bundled (Jar-in-Jar) — no separate installation needed.
- **Space-Modernized** requires **HBM-Modernized `0.3.0-beta.2`** matching the same Minecraft version and loader.

## Bug Reports

Please report any bugs, crashes, or unexpected behavior in the appropriate place:

- **Discord:** `#beta-bug-reports` channel on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/f2BhvzG6CS)
- **HBM-Modernized (core mod) issues:** [Raptor324/HBM-Modernized Issues](https://github.com/Raptor324/HBM-Modernized/issues)
- **Space-Modernized (space-related) issues:** [Raptor324/Space-Modernized Issues](https://github.com/Raptor324/Space-Modernized/issues)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Please report all Space-related bugs** (planets, rockets, orbital stations, atmospheres, life support, space machines, etc.) to the **[Space-Modernized repository](https://github.com/Raptor324/Space-Modernized/issues)** rather than the core HBM-Modernized issue tracker.

When reporting a bug, please include your **Minecraft version & loader** (`1.20.1 Forge` or `1.21.1 NeoForge`), **mod versions**, **steps to reproduce**, and your **`latest.log` / crash report**.
